titulo: Bringing it all into focus—computational microscope captures 25.2 billion pixels per second across a wide field of view
cuerpo: When designing microscopes, optical engineers have long faced a trade-off between speed, field of view and resolution. But improving one of these properties typically comes at the expense of another. Now, a UC Berkeley–led team of researchers has found a way to address this challenge, opening the door to new possibilities in the field of microscopy.
